description: JavaScript file for SuiteCRM theme 'SuiteP', handling UI interactions, layout adjustments, sidebars, popups, and event bindings.

methods.name: loadSidebar
methods.description: Toggles sidebar visibility and updates layout and cookies accordingly.

methods.name: initFooterPopups
methods.description: Initializes footer dialog popups for 'powered by' and 'admin options'.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Shows the specified tab content and hides others.

methods.name: changeFirstTab
methods.description: Changes the first tab content based on clicked element.

methods.name: getParameterByName
methods.description: Retrieves URL parameter value by name.

methods.name: isUserProfilePage
methods.description: Checks if current page is a user profile page.

methods.name: isEditViewPage
methods.description: Checks if current page is an edit view.

methods.name: isDetailViewPage
methods.description: Checks if current page is a detail view.

methods.name: refreshListViewCheckbox
methods.description: Updates checkbox icon state based on checked property.
